policy: VEX-style decisions for vulnerability matches: status not_affected (with justification), affected, fixed (with the Qt release or backport that carries the fix) or under_investigation. A Chrome version range does not account for Qt backports, so each match is triaged here. method records how a decision was reached: backport-commit, source-inspection or patch-level.

vulnerable_code_not_present: the upstream fix (v8 e0562d87ad) guards the Turbofan and Maglev inlining of Array.prototype.sort; the V8 shipped in Qt 6.12.0 sources (src/compiler/js-call-reducer.cc, src/maglev/maglev-graph-builder.cc) has no Array.prototype.sort reduction at all. No backport commit exists. To be confirmed by running the upstream regression test regress-crbug-542403045.js against the shipped engine.

vulnerable_code_present: the upstream fix (v8 36079c36283a, 'Fix side effects of WasmGetOwnProperty builtin', crbug 543557673) replaces a Torque builtin that calls GetPropertyWithReceiver, and so can run JavaScript getters, while Turboshaft treats the call as free of side effects (kEffects = CanReadHeapMemory). The V8 shipped in Qt 6.12.0 contains that pre-fix builtin unchanged (src/builtins/wasm.tq) and the same descriptor; no Qt backport exists up to 2026-10-20. Reachable only from WebAssembly code (Liftoff and Turboshaft call the builtin). The upstream regression test needs --sandbox-testing and is an exploit primitive, so it is not run.

mitigation.summary: WebAssembly is unavailable in the engine by default (V8 --jitless, preference preferences/disableWasm, Settings > Security), removing the only path that reaches the vulnerable builtin. The requested --no-expose-wasm does not exist in the shipped V8 and was measured to have no effect; jitless is the shipped V8's only way to hide WebAssembly and also disables the JavaScript JIT (slower pages, JIT bugs unreachable). The user can turn it back on; the vulnerability stays in the shipped engine, so the status remains affected until a Qt WebEngine release carries the fix.
mitigation.test: cybou_tests --wasm-test (src/security/WasmTests.h): control child compiles a WebAssembly module; stopgap child sees no WebAssembly global. Measured 2026-10-22 on Qt 6.12.0 / Qt WebEngine 6.140.0: control object:true, stopgap undefined.
mitigation.remove: When a Qt WebEngine release with the CVE-2026-87491 backport ships: drop the default in kDisableWasmDefault and record the fix here.
